title: scholarcheck: literature grounding from the command line
description: Answers whether a research claim is already taken, who has extended it, and whether the references cited exist, by querying OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Crossref and arXiv. Withholds any negative verdict while a primary source is unreachable, so a rate-limited lookup is never reported as a fabricated citation.
